Vacancy for Junior Materiovigilance Associate
Tuesday, 19 August 2025
3413 Hits
Recruitment of Junior Materiovigilance Associate at
Medical Devices Adverse Event reporting Monitoring Centre (MDMCs), MGIMS, Sevagram
Name of the Post:
Junior Materiovigilance Associate
(01 Post)
Essential Qualification:
Graduation in Biomedical Engineering/ Clinical Engineering or Master’s in Pharmacy. Good Knowledge of Computers.
Desirable Qualification
:  Any additional training or certification in Materiovigilance / Pharmacovigilance /Clinical Research.
Experience:
0-1 Year experience in Medical Device Industry, Post Market Surveillance/ Medical Devices/ Quality Assurance/ Regulatory Affairs or Quality Management System
Age:
Not exceeding 28 years
Salary:
32,000/- per month
Job Description:
Collection of medical device adverse event (MDAE) Reports.
Processing of MDAE Reports and managing them in ADRMS Software.
Quality review, Clinical Review & Statistical review of medical devices
Any other work assigned by Competent Authority from time to time.
Last date of Application:
10/09/2025 up to 5.00 pm
Applications must be submitted online via the Google Form at the following link:
https://forms.gle/V32aDN8F2UzQuAaQ6
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
